text:
No questions needed. This only registers a local command and doesn't touch any repo, token or device settings.

```sh
claude mcp add tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp
```

Then confirm it registered:

```sh
claude mcp list
```

Optionally, `claude mcp add --scope user tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp` registers it for all your projects rather than just the current one (the default is local scope).

The read tools (`status`, `pool`, `doctor`) work as your normal user. The tools that change the device only work if the MCP server runs as root, and otherwise return an error saying so. For changes like `setup`, `budget set` or `repo add`, run the CLI with `sudo` instead.
